citations.quotedText: And so the plan from here is to file for these licenses next month.

devFindings.title: Q3 buys miss the Robinhood instance
devFindings.claim: All trading revenue (8.5M USD in Q3, including about 1M USD from the 50-50 Robinhood ref share) goes to buybacks.
devFindings.orionReading: Orion measures 7,410,898 USD of treasury buys in Q3 2026 (2026-07-01..09-30), against 8.5M USD disclosed.
devFindings.proposedFix: Find where the Robinhood share is spent on LIT and add it to the holder flow.

citations.quotedText: I should remind everyone that it's a 50-50 ref share.
100% of trading revenue is used for buybacks.

devFindings.title: DefiLlama's revenue overstates Lighter's Q3
devFindings.claim: Lighter disclosed 8.5M USD of Q3 revenue, of which more than 1M USD came from the Robinhood split.
devFindings.orionReading: DefiLlama's dailyRevenue sums to 9,846,397 USD for Q3 2026, against 8.5M USD disclosed.
devFindings.proposedFix: Check how DefiLlama counts the Robinhood instance and label the proxy accordingly.

citations.quotedText: So the total revenue of the quarter, 8.5 million,
already more than a million in fees attributed back to Lighter from the 50-50 split.
